title: klugia zeylanica
intro: Klugia zeylanica, commonly known as the Ceylon tea tree or Indian tea tree, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of India and Sri Lanka. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Klugia zeylanica include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and ease respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
